comment: THIRD REVIEW 2026-10-22 item 3 + USER ruling: Lotus Bloom (any suspend-only card) is NOT castable without suspend. The engine adds no cast=->Suspend match: a `cast=Lotus Bloom` step is rejected with its reason. The VIEWER no longer writes one -- the hand card carries `suspend_only` and every play of its thumb queues the suspend (linebuild.js queueCard; dragonstorm_human_seq_suspend_after_cast is that line). A recorded legacy `cast=Lotus Bloom` line without a sequence still validates through CheckLine's by-name rule, unchanged.
